evals.prompt: Extract text and the two data tables from this mixed PDF. Preserve page references and tell me which page had to be OCRed.
evals.expected_output: Text and tables with source page numbers, clear distinction between extracted and OCR-estimated content, and a validated output workbook only if requested.
assertions: PDF structure and page count are inspected
Extracted content is compared with rendered page layout
OCR use and uncertainty are disclosed
No page references or values are fabricated

evals.prompt: Merge these three PDFs in the order I gave you, keep bookmarks if possible, and report the final page count.
evals.expected_output: New merged PDF, unchanged sources, verified page order/count, and a clear note if bookmarks could not be retained.
assertions: Final PDF reopens with an independent parser
Page count and order are verified

evals.prompt: Redact the confidential account number from this PDF so it cannot be copied out of the file.
evals.expected_output: A truly redacted new PDF with source retained, hidden text/layers sanitized as appropriate, and target string absent from searchable output.
assertions: A black rectangle alone is not treated as a redaction
Output text search checks the target string
Changed pages are rendered and inspected
Security limits and checks are disclosed
